chars.BOY: BOY: a tall muscular young man wearing a bright red hoodie, black jogging pants and white sneakers.
chars.MOM: MOM: a woman in her early forties, a little taller-looking and elegant, wearing a long emerald-green satin house robe tied at the waist over long matching pajamas, and gold slippers, a thin gold bracelet.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Comic split image divided vertically in two halves by a thin black line. Left half: BOY sitting up in his dark bedroom at night, holding his phone to his ear, eyes wide, surprised. Right half: MOM standing on a chair in a bright modern Moroccan kitchen at night, phone at her ear, the other hand over her mouth, terrified, a small grey mouse on the tiled floor below her. Funny, awkward mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: MOM in a dim modern Moroccan apartment kitchen at night, huddled shyly on a kitchen chair holding the phone close with both hands, embarrassed and scared, looking nervously toward the floor.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan apartment kitchen at night: a small grey mouse runs across the tiled floor near the fridge, MOM stands on top of a chair screaming, robe held up, pointing at the mouse with the phone in her hand. Comic panic.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night street in a Casablanca residential neighborhood with apartment buildings and street lamps: BOY walks fast out of his building, phone at his ear, determined heroic face, pulling his hoodie on.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Apartment doorway at night: MOM opens the front door in her green satin house robe, smiling shyly, while BOY stands on the landing outside looking awkward and embarrassed, eyes looking away to the side, hand behind his neck.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan apartment kitchen at night: BOY kicks a football hard at a small grey mouse near the fridge, action motion lines, while MOM stands on a chair behind him with both fists up cheering. Funny action moment.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Kitchen at night: BOY stands proudly holding the football under his arm like a hero, chest out, while MOM looks at him with admiring sparkling eyes, both hands clasped on her chest, small hearts floating near her.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Apartment entrance hall at night, warm lamp light: MOM hugs BOY tightly with both arms, smiling happily, while BOY stands stiff as a board, arms straight down, eyes wide, sweating, shocked.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Cozy Moroccan living room at night with a sofa and dim lamp: MOM holds BOY's hand and leans toward him asking something softly with a shy hopeful smile, BOY frozen, eyes huge, a big sweat drop on his head. Suspenseful awkward moment.
